notes.title: Patch Note 0.10 - Better UI, Visibility, Readybility, New Tutorial and more
notes.notes:
SUM UP
A menu with many new options

Game Tutorial

Heat Tutorial

Display of planet multipliers

Improved visibility of your own rocket

Improved readability of the scoreboard

English and French language support
[previewyoutube="9nsJgDysHoI;full"][/previewyoutube]

IN DETAIL
Display of zone multipliers

Ability to show or hide zones, text, and sound independently

Option to better see your rocket

Option to less see other people’s rockets (you’ll still see rockets achieving a high score)

Option to not fade rockets launched from your own stream via Heat (Twitch)

Sound changes and options to enable/disable various sound effects

Link to the new Instagram and Bluesky accounts (feel free to follow ♥)

Leaderboard

Blue display of the rocket with the best flight time (if outside the top 3)

Local player rocket in the replay even if not in the top 100

Column alignment

Option to underline your score

Option to reduce the number of rows displayed (Top 10* / Top 3*)
* In addition to the Top 10 or Top 3, you’ll always see the rocket with the best time even if it’s not in the top, as well as your own score and the player in front and the player behind you

Rockets score

Separate score display options for your rocket or those of others

Always be able to display rocket details at the top of the leaderboard*
* In addition to the Top 3, you’ll also see the rocket beating the best time even if it’s not in the Top 3

For Twitch streamers

Attempt to stabilize the Heat connection

Attempt to improve the Twitch connection

Heat tutorial

And option to automate its display when an Anonymous player joins the game

Option to show/hide the rules that scroll at the bottom of the screen

Option still hidden but Accessible: CTRL+B = to remove the background:

In the game, you’ll see the background disappear and become black.

On OBS, you can take a « Game Capture » and « Allow Transparency » in its properties.


WHAT'S NEXT ?[p align="start"]I still have many improvements I want to make. These include, but are not limited to:

Daily Maps

Displaying a podium at the end of the game

Being able to play with a keyboard/controller

Transforming the Heatmap into a constellation

Translating into more languages

…
